paidDirectDeliveryCostUsd.meaning: Constructed complete direct episode budget assuming every input is purchased by the donor; includes failed outreach/delivery work and administration. Not an observed gift price.
paidDirectDeliveryCostUsd.excluded: Participant time and broader opportunity costs; no medical cost savings credited.

assumedPlateauUtilityGain.meaning: Signed average utility at established effect across offered recipients, already averaging severity, response and clinical transfer. No positive numerical value is empirically calibrated.

onsetMonths.meaning: Linear ramp from zero to plateau; delayed secondary trial findings motivate caution but do not prove linear onset.

plateauMonths.meaning: Further months at full plateau after ramp, only in separate persistence stress.

realizedExposureFraction.meaning: Runtime and maintenance share of integrated benefit; do not add another adherence multiplier.

fundingAdditionality.meaning: Share of episodes additional to existing funded or substitute provision, assuming equal-effect replacement. Not measured capacity or funding room.

sharedHarmQalyPerAdditionalEpisode.meaning: Nonnegative harm inherent in an additional episode and also present in an identical baseline replacement episode.

donorSpecificHarmQalyPerOffer.meaning: Nonnegative extra burden introduced by this donor intervention even if it creates no additional beneficial service; subtracted outside funding factor.

formulas.classification: incrementalQaly > 0: positive exploratory; == 0: no finite positive estimate; < 0: health-worsening

favorable.costNote: Retains the original annual consumables allowance without refunding unused second-half resources; still unquoted and optimistic.

favorableOneYearPersistence.limits: Unverified second six months at full effect, no added procurement/follow-up cost beyond150 total, annual electricity/filter allowance may be inadequate. No effect beyond12months; no discounting within year.

nonAdditivityAndExclusions: No separate PM reduction, gas removal, exacerbation, mortality, housing or caregiver QALY bonus.
Do not sum Brightline and THC/other partner gains for the same resident/device.

If displaced public devices would have different effects elsewhere, model benefit here minus foregone benefit there; the scalar additionality assumption is insufficient. Do not apply both full displacement and a second equivalent attenuation.
If donor cash is reduced by public or donated inputs, show their full resource value separately; subsidy does not establish extra health.
A replacement-filter-only tranche needs its own no-gift runtime comparator and cannot borrow new-device episode effects.
Suitable non-ozone device, adequate clean-air delivery, tolerated fan speed, electrical safety and correct maintenance are required; ordinary HEPA does not remove gases or remediate mold sources.
None of the positive scenarios is a confidence interval or posterior estimate. Zero or negative utility is credible.
